changelog: Settings page is now fully generic and simpler: no Dayz paths, no Wallingford zip default (weather zip is blank until you enter your own), no personal references anywhere in the UI, errors, or logs — and no library setup on this page at all, because Live TV pulls everything from the guide and needs no library. Everything else from 0.3.0.2 is unchanged (Getting-started box, copyable tuner links, one-click theme apply).
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
